title: Normalized restricted tensor comparison with independent site universes
statement: Let C be a category with independent object and morphism universes, essentially small in coefficient universe u, J a Grothendieck topology, with additive and commutative-ring sheafification, locally-bijective detection for additive sheafification and composition with the commutative-ring forgetful functor. For commutative ring sheaves R,S, a ring-sheaf morphism phi:R -> S, and an R-module sheaf M, there is an isomorphism from Res_phi(S) tensor_R M to Res_phi(changeOfRingsOfUniverses phi M). It sends every local pure tensor s tensor m, through the canonical sheaf-tensor unit, to the sheafification class of the same sectionwise scalar-extension tensor. The supporting interface defines that tensor unit, its naturality, the normalized regular tensor unitor, and the sectionwise predicate for a normalized extension unit. These use the actual tensor of [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], restriction [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], and sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification].

source.place: Tag 03EK, section-tensor-product; sectionwise tensor and module sheafification

proof.text: The sectionwise identity on tensors identifies the tensor presheaf with restricted scalar extension; its naturality is the pure-tensor restriction formula.

Restriction commutes with module sheafification: after forgetting to abelian sheaves the canonical comparison is the identity, hence is invertible. Compose this comparison with tensorObjIsoSheafification. Naturality of the sheafification unit proves the pure-tensor formula. The regular tensor unitor and its inverse section formula follow from the sheafification adjunction triangle identity.

theorem exists_scalarTelescopeTensorComparisonOfUniverses (φ : R ⟶ S)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R)) :
    ∃ e : (cochainModulesMonoidal R).tensorObj
        ((restrictScalars.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map φ)).obj
          (unit.{vC, uC, u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj S))) M ≅
        (restrictScalars.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map φ)).obj
          (changeOfRingsOfUniverses.{vC, uC, u, u} φ M),
      ∀ (V : Cᵒᵖ) (s : S.obj.obj V) (m : M.val.obj V),
        e.hom.val.app V
          ((scalarTelescopeTensorUnitOfUniverses
            ((restrictScalars.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map φ)).obj
              (unit.{vC, uC, u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj S))) M).app V
            ((show ((restrictScalars.{u}
                ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map φ)).obj
                  (unit.{vC, uC, u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj
                    S))).val.obj V
              from s) ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj V] m)) =
        (toSheafify J (changeOfRingsPresheafOfUniverses.{vC, uC, u, u} φ M).presheaf).app V
          (s ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj V, (φ.hom.app V).hom] m)
